description: Roblox charts: the top experiences right now, ranked, each with its current concurrent player count, up and down vote totals, genre and maturity rating. Choose a chart with sort: top-playing-now (default, most concurrent players), top-trending, up-and-coming, fun-with-friends, top-revisited. Sponsored placements are flagged is_sponsored and kept out of the rank unless include_sponsored is true. Player counts are a live snapshot, not a daily average. Sourced from Roblox, Discover charts.

country.description: Two-letter country code in lower case (e.g. "us") or "all" (default).

include_sponsored.description: Include sponsored placements in the ranking (default false).
